verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports bulk work. GraphQL lets one query retrieve data that would otherwise take multiple API calls, and the agent guidance says every list endpoint uses cursor-based pagination and every write accepts an idempotency key. Together these allow bulk reads and safely retried repeated writes, but nothing documents true batch operations. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk write endpoints (e.g., batch upsert/delete across many catalog or inventory items), bulk operations exposed through the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
